# ConfigurableSNNInference

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The ability to adjust network parameters, connectivity, or neuron dynamics at runtime to support different spiking neural network models without hardware redesign. Critical for iNEST to support a wide range of neuromorphic applications and topologies on the same hardware, reducing deployment costs and improving versatility.
